2. This Court at Jaipur Bench in the case of Shyam Prakash Meena & Ors. vs. Union of India & Ors. 
[D.B. Civil Writ Petition No.14258/2024 and other connected writ petitions decided on 19.12.2024]
has allowed the writ petitions and [2024:RJ-JD:52650-DB] (175 of 175) [CW-21129/2024] declared the above note as ultra vires Section 64 (o) read with Section 211 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 as also inoperative in law. 
3. Accordingly, these writ petitions are also allowed in the terms of decision rendered by this Court at Jaipur Bench in the case of Shyam Prakash Meena (supra). In the matter of consideration of application for renewal of fitness certificate filed by the petitioners, the respondents shall not levy any additional fee for each day of delay after expiry of validity period of fitness certificate. We make it clear that no other issue has been considered and the petitions are being allowed only in the manner and to the extent as stated above.
